slideTypes.name: Standard Slide
slideTypes.description: Standard slide where content blocks are stacked.

slideTypes.name: Split Left Image
slideTypes.description: Split layout featuring an image on the left and content on the right.

slideTypes.name: Split Right Image
slideTypes.description: Split layout featuring content on the left and an image on the right.

slideTypes.name: Top Image Banner
slideTypes.description: Top banner image layout with content positioned below.

basic.name: Basic Blocks
basic.description: Essential structural blocks like text, images, tables, and code snippets.

types.name: Large Text
types.description: Large text perfect for main slide titles or big statements.

types.name: Plain Text
types.description: A clean, simple text paragraph layout for long-form descriptions or quotes.

types.name: Single Image
types.description: A single prominent image occupying maximum space, suitable for high-impact visual slides.

types.name: Image Gallery
types.description: A dynamic grid gallery displaying multiple images beautifully.

types.name: Table
types.description: A clean, flexible data table layout for presenting structured information in rows and columns.

types.name: Code Block
types.description: A preformatted code block for displaying source code.

bullets.name: Bullet Points
bullets.description: Standard lists or grids containing multiple sequential headers and descriptions.

types.name: Simple List
types.description: A classic vertical list of items, splitting into multiple columns when needed. Best for general text outlines.

types.name: Bullets Grid
types.description: A structured grid of bullet items with headers and descriptions. Best for comparisons or scanning multiple points.

types.name: Numbered List
types.description: A sequential list with prominent numbers instead of basic bullets. Best for step-by-step processes or top lists.

types.name: Accent Bullets
types.description: A refined list where items are highlighted with horizontal accent bars.

cards.name: Card Layouts
cards.description: Grid or block cards to visually separate and present grouped data.

types.name: Basic Cards
types.description: Clean border-based card grid for showcasing features or items side-by-side cleanly.

types.name: Outline Cards
types.description: Stylish card layout with subtle top accent bars and outlined borders. Best for highlight lists or structured features.

types.name: Numbered Cards
types.description: Card grid featuring prominent step/sequence numbers in each card header. Best for multi-step processes or numbered features.

types.name: Accent Cards
types.description: Card layout with distinct header banner backgrounds and clean accent divider lines. Best for grouping distinct concepts or highlighted features.

icons.name: Icon Layouts
icons.description: Visual layouts featuring prominent icons to represent concepts.

types.name: Icons Grid
types.description: A structured grid of items prominently featuring a large icon for each. Best for visualizing abstract features or key capabilities.

types.name: Icons Card
types.description: Card grid with prominent icons for each item. Ideal for feature highlights.

types.name: Icons List
types.description: A vertical list of items prominently featuring an icon on the left. Best for detailing specific features or steps.

stats.name: Key Metrics & Statistics
stats.description: Large text indicators highlighting critical figures or metrics.

types.name: Stats Grid
types.description: Grid display of key numbers and metrics. Best for dashboard summaries and showing performance KPIs at once.

types.name: Stat Highlight
types.description: Emphasizes a single key metric with a prominent number and detailed callout description.

timelines.name: Timeline Layouts
timelines.description: Visual horizontal and vertical timeline tracks to represent milestones, project phases, or sequential stages.

types.name: Vertical Timeline
types.description: A vertical timeline track with nodes alternating left and right, complete with connector lines.

types.name: Horizontal Timeline
types.description: A horizontal timeline track with nodes alternating top and bottom, perfect for broad milestones.

types.name: Chevron Timeline
types.description: A horizontal sequence of connected chevron arrows with description text alternating top and bottom.

charts.name: Data Visualization
charts.description: Visual charts including bar, line, area, and pie charts.

types.name: Bar Chart
types.description: A responsive bar chart for comparing quantities. Uses 'header' for label and 'chartValue' for numeric data.

types.name: Line Chart
types.description: A responsive line chart for showing trends over time. Uses 'header' for label and 'chartValue' for numeric data.

types.name: Area Chart
types.description: A responsive area chart with filled gradient for showing volume/trends. Uses 'header' for label and 'chartValue' for numeric data.

types.name: Pie Chart
types.description: A responsive pie chart for showing percentages or parts of a whole. Uses 'header' for label and 'chartValue' for numeric data.
